root.name: ウエスチングハウス・エア・ブレーキ・テクノロジーズ

relations.text: エボリューション・シリーズ機関車の納入と長期保守で合意した
relations.text_en: Agreed to deliver Evolution Series locomotives and provide long-term service support

source.label: Wabtec 10-K(2025-12-31)
source.quote: In the third quarter of 2025, Wabtec announced an agreement with National Company Kazakhstan Temir Zholy ("KTZ"), the national railway of Kazakhstan, to deliver Evolution Series locomotives and provide long-term service support.

relations.text: 製品や地域によっては、顧客である中国中車とも競合する
relations.text_en: In some product lines and regions Wabtec also competes with its customer CRRC

source.label: Wabtec 10-K(2025-12-31)
source.quote: Depending on the product line and geography, we can also compete with our customers, such as CRRC Corporation Limited, a China-based manufacturer of rolling stock.

companies.name: ノーフォーク・サザン

relations.text: ノーフォーク・サザンから3年連続でサステナビリティ・パートナー賞を受けた
relations.text_en: Received the Thoroughbred Sustainability Partner Award from Norfolk Southern three years in a row

source.label: Wabtec 10-K(2025-12-31)
source.quote: This was Wabtec’s third year in a row receiving the Thoroughbred Sustainability Partner Award from Norfolk Southern.

relations.text: 子会社を通じ北米の主要な競合先であり、北米以外では最大の競合先である
relations.text_en: Its subsidiary is a principal North American OEM competitor, and Knorr is the main competitor elsewhere

source.label: Wabtec 10-K(2025-12-31)
source.quote: Within North America, New York Air Brake Company, a subsidiary of the German air brake producer Knorr-Bremse AG (“Knorr”) and Amsted Rail Company, Inc., a subsidiary of Amsted Industries Corporation, are our principal overall OEM competitors.

companies.name: アムステッド・インダストリーズ

relations.text: 子会社のアムステッド・レールを通じ北米の主要な競合先である
relations.text_en: Its subsidiary Amsted Rail is a principal overall OEM competitor in North America

source.label: Wabtec 10-K(2025-12-31)
source.quote: Within North America, New York Air Brake Company, a subsidiary of the German air brake producer Knorr-Bremse AG (“Knorr”) and Amsted Rail Company, Inc., a subsidiary of Amsted Industries Corporation, are our principal overall OEM competitors.

relations.text: 傘下のプログレス・レールが機関車の主な競合先である
relations.text_en: Its unit Progress Rail is the primary competitor for locomotives

source.label: Wabtec 10-K(2025-12-31)
source.quote: Our primary competition for locomotives is Progress Rail, owned by a subsidiary of Caterpillar.

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係だけを載せています。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
note.en: Only relationships confirmed in official materials are shown. Not investment advice.
